intro.title: Parallel motion
intro.text: Both hands play the same tune shape at the same time, a 10th apart: the left hand starts on A2 while the right starts on C4. Same direction, same finger pattern in reverse: right thumb, left pinky.

intro.title: Why a 10th
intro.text: Hands a 10th apart sound full and stay out of each other's way. (Exact octaves are common too, but the mic can't tell the upper octave from the lower one.)
